$comment: packages/preflight/checks.json — check command table (data, not code). The orchestrator runs these as argv arrays via Bun.spawn; a shell is never invoked. Elements are trusted repo-owned configuration, not user input; the single CLI-supplied argv element (the build-memory subject appended after 'status') is validated by isValidMemorySubject() before use. 'requires' names a path that must exist under the repo root or the check SKIPs with an explicit reason.

tsc.doc: the repo's own verify-backbone typecheck; root tsconfig covers packages + apps

test.doc: full bun test at the repo root — same backbone as verify

tui-chaos.doc: tui-chaos's supported fixture/chaos entry, reused verbatim

memory.doc: mad-build-memory status <subject>; exit 0 VALID, 1 not VALID (STALE/UNKNOWN/INVALIDATED), 2 contract error
